name: Nelentu
body:
NELENTU
CR 7

XP 3,200
N Medium magical beast (augmented animal)
Init +2; Senses emotionsense 30 ft., low-light vision; Perception +15

DEFENSE

AC 20, touch 12, flat-footed 18 (+2 Dex, +5 natural, +3 armor)
hp 85 (9d10+36)
Fort +10, Ref +8, Will +6

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft., fly 20 ft. (poor)
Melee zero-edge longsword +13/+8 (1d8+3 S, 19–20/×2), claw +8 (1d4+1 B&S) or 2 claws +13 (1d4+3 B&S)
Ranged laser rifle +11/+6 touch (2d6 fire, range incr. 150 ft., automatic)

STATISTICS

Str 17 (+3); Dex 14 (+2); Con 18 (+4); Int 18 (+4); Wis 12 (+1); Cha 14 (+2)
Base Atk +9; CMB +12; CMD 24
Feats Alertness, Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes, Point-Blank Shot, Technologist
Skills Acrobatics +14, Climb +15, Fly +10, Knowledge (nature) +13, Perception +15, Sense Motive +14; Species Modifiers +2 Sense Motive
Languages Common, up to 4 others; limited telepathy 30 ft.

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Emotionsense (Ex)

See above.

Limited Telepathy (Su)

See above.

ECOLOGY

Environment any forest or urban
Organization solitary, pair, or commune (3–6)
Treasure standard (freebooter armor, zero-edge longsword, laser rifle, 2 silverdisk batteries [10 charges each], other treasure)

The nelentu are one such example of an entu symbiote species. Originally a species of awkward, fruit-eating batlike creatures known as neleks, they were a species facing extinction on a remote jungle planet until they entered a new stage of their evolution by entering symbiosis with the entu.
